heading: Germany's Merz Says State Election Result Marks 'Deep Turning Point'
author: Bloomberg News Editorial
paragraphs: Chancellor Friedrich Merz speaks at a news conference about the election in the Baltic coast state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, which resulted in his Christian Democratic Union party crashing out of a regional parliament for the first time in the country’s post-World War II history. (Translated into English from German.) (Source: Bloomberg)
